summary: Initializes a 3-dword allocator node head stored at global off_5E9AC0, with two paths selected by global dword_8D3F3C. When dword_8D3F3C is nonzero: allocate a 48-byte zeroed block via sub_58AB58(1, 48); if the allocation fails return 1; if sub_58F7C9 initializes the new node and reports failure, free the node (MultiFieldFree_f8eb then sub_58AA6F) and return 1; otherwise copy the three dword fields of the current head off_5E9AC0 into the new node, install the new node as the head, free the old head dword_8D3F68, and store the new node in dword_8D3F68. When dword_8D3F3C is zero: copy the three head dword fields into a static 3-field sentinel at off_5E9A90/off_5E9A94/off_5E9A98, repoint off_5E9AC0 at the sentinel, free the old head dword_8D3F68, and clear dword_8D3F68 to 0. Returns 0 on success in both paths.

local_names.v1: new node pointer (same as v0), treated as a 3-dword head

operations.description: Branch on global dword_8D3F3C: nonzero selects the dynamic-allocate path, zero selects the static-sentinel path.
Allocate a zero-initialized 48-byte block with sub_58AB58(1, 48); store it as the new node.
If the allocation returned null, return 1 (failure) without touching the list.
Initialize the new node via sub_58F7C9(v0); a nonzero return marks node initialization as failed.
On initialization failure: free the node's internal multi-fields via MultiFieldFree_f8eb(v1), free the node block via sub_58AA6F(v1), and return 1.
Copy the three dword fields of the current head into the new node: v1[0..2] = off_5E9AC0[0..2].
Install the new node as the list head: off_5E9AC0 = v1.
Free the old head dword_8D3F68: release its internal multi-fields via MultiFieldFree_f8eb, then free the block via sub_58AA6F.
Store the new node as the tracked head: dword_8D3F68 = v1.
Static-sentinel path: copy the three head dword fields into the static sentinel off_5E9A90/off_5E9A94/off_5E9A98.
Repoint the list head at the static sentinel: off_5E9AC0 = &off_5E9A90.
Free the old head dword_8D3F68 (MultiFieldFree_f8eb then sub_58AA6F) on the static-sentinel path as well.
Clear the tracked head: dword_8D3F68 = 0 on the static-sentinel path.
Both successful paths return 0; only the failed-allocation and failed-init branches return 1.
